title: Electrical Enclosure Types by NEMA
description: Reference guide for NEMA electrical enclosure types used in hazardous and non-hazardous locations, including their classifications, protection features, and applications.

rows: General Purpose
Indoor
Incidental contact protection, falling dirt protection
Enclosures constructed for indoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and to provide a degree of protection against falling dirt.
Drip-Proof
Indoor
Incidental contact, falling dirt, dripping and light splashing

Enclosures constructed for indoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment, to provide a degree of protection against falling dirt, and to provide a degree of protection against dripping and light splashing of liquids.
Dust tight, Rain tight, Sleet tight
Outdoor
Falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, windblown dust, ice resistance

Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and to provide a degree of protection against falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, and windblown dust.
3R
Rain tight, Sleet Resistant
Outdoor
Falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, ice resistance

Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and to provide a degree of protection against falling dirt, rain, sleet, and snow.
3S
Dust tight, Rain tight, Sleet tight (Operable)
Outdoor
Falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, windblown dust, operable mechanisms in ice

Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and external mechanism(s) remain operable when ice laden.
Watertight, Dust tight, Sleet Resistant
Indoor & Outdoor
Falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, windblown dust, splashing water, hose-directed water, ice resistance

Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and to provide a degree of protection against falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, windblown dust, splashing water, and hose-directed water.
4X
Watertight, Dust tight, Corrosion-Resistant
Indoor & Outdoor
Falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, windblown dust, splashing water, hose-directed water, corrosion resistance, ice resistance

Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and to provide a degree of protection against falling dirt, rain, sleet, snow, windblown dust, splashing water, hose-directed water, and corrosion.
Dust tight, Drip-Proof
Indoor
Falling dirt, airborne dust lint fibers, dripping and light splashing

Enclosures constructed for indoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and to provide a degree of protection against falling dirt and settling airborne dust, lint, fibers, and flyings.
Occasionally Submersible, Watertight, Sleet Resistant
Indoor & Outdoor
Falling dirt, hose-directed water, occasional temporary submersion, ice resistance

Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and against hose-directed water and the entry of water during occasional temporary submersion at a limited depth.
6P
Watertight, Sleet Resistant Prolonged Submersion
Indoor & Outdoor
Falling dirt, hose-directed water, prolonged submersion, ice resistance

Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and against hose-directed water and the entry of water during prolonged submersion at a limited depth.
Dust tight and Drip tight (No Knockouts)
Indoor
Falling dirt, circulating dust lint fibers, dripping and light splashing

Enclosures constructed without knockouts for indoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and against falling dirt, circulating dust, lint, fibers, and flyings.
Dust tight and Drip tight (With Knockouts)
Indoor
Falling dirt, circulating dust lint fibers, dripping and light splashing, knockouts provided

Enclosures constructed with knockouts for indoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and against falling dirt, circulating dust, lint, fibers, and flyings.
Oil tight and Dust tight
Indoor
Falling dirt, circulating dust lint fibers, spraying splashing and seepage of water oil and coolants

Enclosures constructed for indoor use to provide a degree of protection to personnel against incidental contact with the enclosed equipment and against falling dirt, circulating dust, lint, fibers, and flyings.
Class I, Group A, B, C or D
Indoor
Hazardous location protection, Class I Division 1
Enclosures constructed for indoor use in hazardous locations classified as Class I, Division 1, Groups A, B, C, or D as defined in NFPA 70.
Class I, Group A, B, C or D
Indoor & Outdoor
Hazardous location protection, Class I Division 1
Enclosures constructed for either indoor or outdoor use in hazardous locations classified as Class I, Division 1, Groups A, B, C, and D as defined in NFPA 70.
Class II, Group E, F or G
Indoor
Hazardous location protection, Class II Division 1
Enclosures constructed for indoor use in hazardous locations classified as Class II, Division 1, Groups E, F, or G as defined in NFPA 70.
Mine Safety and Health Administration
Indoor & Outdoor
Mining application requirements, MSHA compliance
Enclosures constructed to meet the requirements of the Mine Safety and Health Administration, 30 CFR, Part 18.
